caption: The drawing shows a rectangular area divided into various sections and populated with objects arranged in an organized fashion. The image primarily utilizes shades of green for the fields, trees, and grass areas, with some patches in light brown, blue, yellow, and purple. Scattered throughout the area are clusters and rows of circular green shapes representing trees or bushes. Several rectangular and square patches of varying colors indicate garden beds or cultivated plots. There are small, white buildings with red roofs positioned around the perimeter, with five along the upper edge, five lining the lower right, and three on the bottom left. Two larger, dark green tree shapes are present near the top corners. The boundary of the area is marked with a thin pinkish-red line forming a fence-like enclosure. The central portion features symmetric, geometric arrangements with colored rectangles and squares, possibly representing formal gardens or paths. The overall layout consists of a mixture of trees, crop fields, gardens, and buildings, distributed throughout the fenced-in area.
title: Dutch Garden Plan
